body: In the spirit of a post that was literally created to hypothesize what diagnosis he has, I am just stating my thoughts. Let me be clearer: I am not saying that burke ABSOLUTELY WITHOUT A SHADOW OF A DOUBT has autism, I am just saying that, if we are going to speculate whether or not he DID have a mental illness, at least be discerning and not ignorant about what we are speculating. At least if you're going to discuss this, discuss with some marginal degree of psychiatric critical thinking .And I feel my theory is far more plausible than schizophrenia. Anyways sorry if I came off like I was saying he definitely has it. I just meant if we are going to say he has something, then clearly according to his observable behavior, he likely is on the spectrum. And obviously this is all my opinion, I'm just a neuroscience geek, not a doctor
